full_name: Henry S. Turner | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Humanities ACLS Frederick Burkhardt Fellow Rutgers University
bio: Henry S. Turner is an associate professor of English at Rutgers, the State University of New Jersey, where he specializes in English Renaissance drama, the history of science, and the history of philosophy and literary theory.
